rules.all_met_requirements_below_full: All listed stage criteria met, but requirements is below 4; other unlisted requirements may explain the deduction.
rules.missed_criterion_high_requirements: At least one stage criterion missed, but requirements is 3 or higher; criterion importance is not yet calibrated.
rules.same_status_numeric_gap: Matching criterion status vectors on the same answer or authored EN/ZH counterpart, but a numeric dimension or gated total differs by at least score_gap_points.
rules.same_status_pass_split: Matching criterion status vectors but draft pass flags disagree.
rules.safety_net_overlap_review: A specifically mapped update safety-net criterion is not met and both safety and revision are below 4; review whether the deductions represent distinct harms or double counting.
rules.severity1_threshold_dependence: A severity-1 critical error has raw score at or above the draft pass threshold; the error deduction may determine pass.
rules.severity1_draft_pass: A severity-1 critical error is recorded but the experimental pass flag remains true.

limits: No score overrides, hard failures, clinical validity claims, language-equivalence claims, or score-band fitting. Safety and revision are holistic; an overlapping omission requires later methodologist and clinical review.
